s1.p8: What else makes instances of **⟦f6⟧** so convenient for us?
s1.p10:
The **⟦f7⟧** instance is a **microtask**, and microtasks have their own queue, the priority of which is higher than the priority of the task queue.

I.e. while the fat and sluggish tasks will stupidly sit in their queue and wait for the ‘office’ (**Call Stack**) to be vacated, microtasks one by one will jump past them into the ‘office’. And until the last microtask from the privileged queue passes through the **Call Stack**, the tasks will wait.
